# Game images

PNG/GIF/JPG used by the legacy `game/` UI live in this folder. Sync from `game/public/assets/images/` when updating art.

Referenced paths include:

- `hack-box.png`, `hacked.png`, `luck.png`, `gold.png`
- `treasure1.png`, `treasure2.png`, `treasure3.png`
- `gold1.png`, `gold2.png`, `gold3.png`
- `gold-bg.jpg`, `bgbtn.png`, `gif.gif`
- `king.gif` (Facts podium)
- `hacking_game.png`, `gold_quest.png`, `animalTestImg.png` (fallback logos)

Icons: `../icons/`. BGM: `../112.mp3`, `../monkey.mp3`.

## Legacy CSS

Student stylesheets are copied into `../css/` by:

`abutabl-student/scripts/copy-legacy-game-css.sh`

(run after changing files under `game/public/css/student/`).
